findings: Regex filters catch style (emoji, openers, length, slang) but not robot capability, role tracking or relational boundaries.
Robot and boundary families carry most critical failures; the teacher often accepts physical or relational requests.
Cue labels skew to smile (about 200/236); 'concerned' and intensity 2 never appear, even for refusals.
'solid' and 'Whoa, that's awesome' recur in balanced_positive; acceptable per reply, repetitive as a corpus.
